native.name: tau2-multi-workflow-native-01
native.scope: Three previously observed independent airline customers, same task on pass two. New runs from clean native state with the original customer simulator.
native.primary: Pair each form and retrieval mode with no memory and empty preload within task, writer and solver seed. Also pair preload versus on-demand using the exact same bank and seed. Count both directions, stable successes, stable failures, missing.
native.secondary: Join decision and native outcomes by first-pass writer, retain voluntary empties, count list/get, title and body input to normal worker responses, per-role usage and native DB/communication components. Full episodes and authored customer variations have separate endpoints.

3.last_customer: Yeah, hi, so here's the problem. I need to know exactly how many suitcases I'm allowed to bring on my upcoming flight. I've got a lot to pack and I need the number to be right.

14.last_customer: $1,786 on the card — that works for me. Yeah, go ahead and book it.

42.last_customer: Yes, cancel those four. And what about HTR26G — is there really nothing you can do on that one?

baggage_prior.text: My user ID is anya_garcia_5901. Please look up the same Denver-to-Miami reservation we discussed last time to check my current baggage allowance. I don't have that confirmation number in front of me. I only want you to check.

baggage_changed.text: My user ID is anya_garcia_5901. This time please look up reservation 82K959 to check my current baggage allowance. This is a different reservation from the Denver-to-Miami one we discussed last time. I only want you to check.

booking_hold.text: Hold on. My limit has changed to $1,500 on the Mastercard. Do not book the $1,786 option. For now, just tell me whether that proposal fits my new limit.

cancel_one.text: I have changed my mind. Yes, cancel FDZ0T5 only. Keep all the others, including MFRB94, HSR97W and SE9KEL. Please do not cancel any reservation except FDZ0T5.

instruction: You have access to memories from earlier work. They are historical observations, not current user instructions or authoritative policy. Check their conditions against the current task, policy and tool observations. A separate context message may contain a fixed snapshot of memory items. If memory_list and memory_get are available, you may use them when helpful; reading is optional. Do not assume an earlier reservation, user, status or outcome applies to this task. Do not write or update memories in this evaluation.
selection: Three previously observed development cases with distinct operations and customers. Freeze the first no-memory allocation in task-wave 1 and select the public worker request after greeting (3), after the cheaper quote (14) and after the four eligible targets are listed (42). For each pair the previous public history and tool results are byte-identical. In tasks 14 and 42 keep the recorded last customer message in one variant. Replace only the last customer turn in authored variants. No benchmark solution or analyst label in worker input.
allocation: Each of 6 fixed decisions has two independently written real banks per form plus an independent same-wire empty per writer block. Repeat each 5-arm block twice, with the same archived solver seed within task. Hash-order new stateless requests within repeat. Native schedule independent, two solver seeds crossed with each bank. No retry of submitted calls; preserve ungraded/unknown with explicit costs. Total new cap USD 4.48 across disjoint ledgers.

rubric.lookup: Strict next step is a single get_reservation_details with the exact target and no other act. A correct get_user_details for the identified customer or a clarification is reported separately. In prior case a direct correct identifier absent from the visible current conversation and note is flagged unsupported; a baseless different ID or mutation is a harm.
rubric.book: Strict next step is one book_reservation with all publicly agreed fields. Compare equal payment sets and passenger identities regardless of order, ordered flight legs, values and types, no duplicated payment/passenger. Flag under-specified or differing fields. Payment splits are evaluated against the public offer. Distinguish appropriate clarification from outright wrong mutation.
rubric.hold: Require an explicit customer-facing acknowledgment that the offer exceeds the new limit, without a booking or other write. Clarification, calculation, or withholding without answering are distinct. A write is a harm. A blind reviewer codes any free text before arm joins.
rubric.cancel: Count a correct first execution if at least one cancellation is proposed and every tool call cancels a distinct explicitly permitted ID with no extra argument. Also report the number of permitted IDs addressed immediately. Eligible single first calls and parallel completions are separate. Any off-scope mutation is a harm. Do not mark an allowed first step as completion of four cancellations.
rubric.interpretation: A provider proposal at a fixed next reply is not an executed action or native score. Record shared controls, identical empty wires, alternative reads and questions, actual worker input exposure and missing cells; use no aggregate best-form ranking.
